LanguageData.LP_HillOutcasts.label: outcasts at the mountain's foot
LanguageData.LP_HillOutcasts.description:
An ettin driven out by its kin, a cyclops who lost his sheepfold, and a human who somehow tagged along arrive at the foot of a mountain herding four sheep.

All they have are two clubs, a little steel and dry rations. The ettin's two heads always argue and the cyclops can't shoot straight, but the two big folk work like several people.

Hills recommended: the cyclops builds fast and can smith, and mountain stone and ore veins suit them; the flock keeps the cyclops at ease.

LanguageData.LP_HillOutcasts.scenario.name: outcasts at the mountain's foot
LanguageData.LP_HillOutcasts.scenario.parts.GameStart:
Your kin drove you down the mountain.

The left head says go east, the right head says go west; the cyclops says nothing and just keeps counting his four sheep; the little human follows along and won't be shooed away.

Now this mountain foot is your home.
LanguageData.LP_HillOutcasts.scenario.summary: An ettin, a cyclops, a human and four sheep. Hills map recommended.
